metadata.title: Invariant complex Finsler metrics on reductive complex homogeneous spaces
metadata.abstract: Let $(M=G/H,J)$ be a reductive complex homogeneous space and $F$ be a $G$-invariant strongly pseudoconvex complex Finsler metric on $M$. Using the adapted $(1,0)$-frame field obtained by parallel transformation with respect to the canonical connection on $M$, we obtain the necessary and sufficient condition for $F$ to be a Kähler-Finsler metric (resp. weakly Kähler-Finsler metric) in terms of Lie-bracket. The curvature tensor of the complex Rund connection associated to $F$ is then decomposed into an algebraic part and a derivative part, yielding explicit formulas for the holomorphic bisectional curvature and holomorphic sectional curvature of $F$, respectively. As an application, we give a Lie-theoretic proof of the rigidity theorem: every $G$-invariant strongly pseudoconvex complex Finsler metric on a complex symmetric manifold $M=G/H$ is necessarily a Kähler--Berwald metric.
